avis.titre: Pleasantly Surprised — Gentle, Refreshing, and Leaves Skin SoftPleasantly Surprised — Gentle, Refreshing, and Leaves Ski
avis.texte: I did some research about the clumps people said to be dead skin: "The gel contains protease enzymes (like papain from papaya) that help loosen dead skin cells, so there’s a chemical exfoliant component. There’s also cellulose in the formula. Cellulose is a substance that doesn’t dissolve in water, so as you massage the gel, the cellulose fibers clump together. These clumps help pick up dead skin and dirt, essentially giving a gentle physical exfoliation." ----- My review: I’ve only used this peeling gel once so far, but I wanted to share my early impressions. Like other reviewers mentioned, it does form clumps as you massage it in. From my understanding, this is mostly the cellulose in the product reacting on the skin—not necessarily old dead skin like some people assume. It can pick up some dirt and debris, but the clumps themselves aren’t proof of heavy exfoliation. That said, my skin felt noticeably clean, smooth, and refreshed afterward. What stood out the most was how soft and moisturized my skin felt. Unlike some exfoliators that leave my face tight or dry, this one actually left it supple and hydrated. My only complaint is the vague instructions. It says to use a “moderate amount,” but that’s not very helpful. What’s considered moderate? A pea-size? A quarter-size? Also, I personally wouldn’t recommend using this more than once a day—too much exfoliation can cause dryness or irritation over time. Overall, I’m really enjoying it so far. avis.titre: Sticks to peach fuzz, removing it hurts & requires oil.
avis.texte: I love peeling exfoliants. I am always on the lookout for a new one that will live up to or do better than my go-to: 'sparkling lemon' relatively inexpensive but most effective brand (secret key). The problems I had with this one aren't unique. It creates more product build-up than necessary and I don't care for all that crap falling off my face. I'm aware it will be some product as well as skin from both face & fingertips. I like when I can tell that it's working, instead of just having a bunch of pilled-up goo stuck to me. And that, really, is the biggest problem: it sticks to my baby hairs and I have to pull it off in little, well, really it's exactly like when a sweater pills, it was just tiny tight balls of product + dead skin caught on my peach fuzz. As into exfoliating as I am I'm not a microblade kind of girl, and if you are? Go buck wild, you're relatively immune to the real issue, the extra product isn't a PROBLEM problem. It does the job fine, it's just more STUFF than I like. Pulling those stuck bits of product off those tiny sensitive cheek hairs HURT! I had to use straight coconut oil to get it loose, and that's not the point in my routine where I want something oil-based so I have to wash my face again and really it's a lot of inconvenience for something so simple. I used another brand of facial peeling gel for years but I wanted to switch to a more affordable product. ma:nyo Galactomy peeling gel, looks more like cream than a gel, is very affordable but it gets the same results as more (outrageously) expensive brands. I read the reviews about customers saying that the “balling effect” we get is only the breakdown of the gel and not the removal of dead skin. Yes, the peeling gel disintegrates when rubbed onto the skin (same effect as when you use an eraser to rub out pencil drawing) BUT this is the way the product works. It gently exfoliates the skin by lifting dead skin and impurities and binding them with the gel, hence the gommage effect. Peeling gels, in my opinion, are far better than conventional facial scrubs as they are more gentle on your skin and not gritty. I will agree that this peeling gel is a bit of a pain to rinse but I would say that despite the inconvenience, stick to it. After a few uses, you will notice you have less impurities to remove, you will use less of the gel, therefore less effort to rinse. Make sure your hair is away from your face though, as it can stick to it. Then again, the same thing can be said for any exfoliant. Also, rinse your face with lots of lukewarm water and finish with a splash cold water. From my experience, when I first started using a peeling gel, I used it every other day. I used to get a lot of grime but nowadays, I only do it once every two weeks or so as my needs to exfoliate has reduc
I have oily skin and my pores are constantly clogged. I use this peeling gel twice a week, it cleanses pores very well, exfoliates dead cells, resulting in incredibly radiant skin.

It feels super comfortable on the skin. I have dry and sensitive skin and didn’t experience any irritation. The texture is very gentle yet it exfoliates and cleans from the first use. Since I don’t usually have many impurities this product worked perfectly for me. I’m not sure if it shows as much on camera but I definitely noticed a difference. These photos are after just one use.

I absolutely love this peeling gel. The formula is incredibly gentle yet effective, giving my skin a smooth and refreshed feel every time I use it. The scent deserves a special mention — it’s light, clean, and very pleasant, making the whole experience feel calming. The silky texture spreads easily without any harsh or gritty feeling and rinses off cleanly, leaving my skin soft, not tight or irritated. I also appreciate how gentle it is — even on sensitive skin days it never causes redness. At the same time, it delivers visible results: my face looks brighter, smoother, and more even, and makeup applies better afterward. It’s one of those products that gives you that fresh, healthy-looking glow without any effort. For the quality and results, the value for money is excellent. A little goes a long way, so the tube lasts longer than I expected. Overall, this has become one of my favorite Manyo products, and I truly enjoy using it every time. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Excelente para pieles con rosacea y acné
avis.texte: Tengo acne y rosacea, este producto me ha servido muchísimo para exfoliar mi piel sin irritarla, huele riquísimo, y sensación después de aplicarlo es increíble, te deja la piel super suave! Lo uso una vez a la semana.

Purchased this after my younger sister (in her late 20s, dry skin, acne prone) raved about how soft and smooth it made her face look and feel. I’m not sure what’s wrong with my face, but when I used it (I have very normal skin, leaning more dry than oily), it balled up and STUCK to my face!! The balling up is normal she said, but having the minuscule balls stuck to the hairs on my face was definitely not normal. She said the balls (product and dead skin cells) should wash right off with water. I had to literally scrape my cheeks to get the tiny white balls off. I tried pre-washing my face before using this product, I tried using soap after using the product to remove the balls, I tried different methods to get it to work for me but it still kept balling up on my lower cheeks/jawline. It was the strangest thing. A couple of my other sisters purchased it and used it with no issues, but one of my older sisters (I have six sisters, so many testers) had the same balling effect happen to them, too! I wanted to love it and tried for weeks, but ended up giving it to one of my older sisters who didn’t have the issues I had with it.
I loved it, I love this product. Every time I use it, it leaves my skin very clean and very soft. This is my favorite. I will continue using it because it is excellent. I highly recommend it.

I've been using it for a month now, and I didn't like it after the first application. It immediately caused breakouts. I don't know, maybe my skin just reacts this way, but the result is always the same: every time I try it, I get pimples.

Before I tell you how amazing this stuff is, let me tell you about the one thing they need to change. This peel comes with no directions. For guidance on how to use it I needed to go back to the product page. Why they don't include suggestions and tips with the packaging is beyond me, but doing so would be a big help to user. The good news is that I can overlook that small shortcoming because this stuff works so well. The first time I used it I was a little worried about overdoing it, so I just rubbed it on my face for a few seconds before washing it off. As soon as I finished rinsing it away I was like, "Whoa!". My skin was so smooth it was kind of amazing. If you have trouble getting rid of dead skin on your face like me, I highly recommend this stuff. It gave me the best results with the least amount of effort and irritation of any product I have tried, hands down. I am not even sure how it can work so well, so fast without irritating your skin, but it does. If you are looking for an exfoliant that actually gets the job done, this is the one I would recommend you try before all others. This gets both thumbs all the way up from me.

avis.titre: Easy to use, a unique way to get a gentle exfoliation :)

Other than that, I truly loved everything about this. The gel glides smoothly across the skin and feels quite gentle on the face as well. After washing off your dead skin cells, it will leave you softer skin that feels great. I have oily combination skin that gets sensitive depending on my hormonal cycle, and I didn’t have any issue with this gel. If you haven’t tried this type of peeling gel before, give this one a shot. This one is a good quality peeling gel and a cost effective choice in my opinion compared to other similar types of gels I have used from Korea.
